t: A 14 week middle school course that pairs unplugged activities with micro:bit projects.
steps: Find the MakeCode CS Intro course home page.
Review the 13 lessons and the standards alignment.
Order micro:bit boards for the programming lessons.
Ask IT to confirm that student devices can open the MakeCode editor.
Print the unplugged materials for Lesson 1.
Teach the 30 minute unplugged activity first.
Follow it with the micro:bit activity.
